issue: Fabricated loan application case number synthesized on client when API fails or in demo fallback
user_impact: User is presented with a fake loan case number (LN-XXXXX) that does not exist in backend database; user believes loan application was submitted
recommended_fix: Return error and show failure state instead of synthesizing caseNo; make caseNo nullable or await server confirmation
regression_test_idea: Mock network error in loan apply; assert no LN- case number is generated and user sees error dialog

issue: Fabricated investment ID synthesized on client during mock/delay flow
user_impact: User sees an active investment with ID INV-XXXXXX but server has no record of the funds or escrow contract
recommended_fix: Gate behind DemoAccountService.isDemoInterceptionAllowedNow or disable commercial investment until backend endpoint is integrated
regression_test_idea: Verify commercial controller executeInvestment fails loudly when demo mode is false and no backend endpoint exists

issue: Fabricated stock order number synthesized on client when service returns null
user_impact: User receives confirmation of stock order ORD-XXXXX in PENDING_BROKER state that was never sent to real broker
recommended_fix: Throw user-facing exception when broker order fails; never insert client-synthesized order into orders list
regression_test_idea: Mock stock order null response; assert orders list length remains unchanged and error message displayed

issue: Fabricated train booking reference synthesized locally
user_impact: User believes train booking is confirmed with EC-RAIL-XXXXX reference but ticket was never issued
recommended_fix: Connect to real travel booking API or mark booking strictly as demo voucher with clear disclaimer
regression_test_idea: Verify train booking emits error toast instead of fake EC-RAIL reference when backend is uncontactable

issue: Aborted or canceled gateway WebView deposit routes to success step with celebratory confirmation and PAID receipt
user_impact: User closes or cancels payment gateway without paying; app treats deposit as completed successfully and shows PAID receipt
recommended_fix: Route to pending or canceled state when paymentResult is null or false; never set currentStep to 2 (success) on aborted payment
regression_test_idea: Open add money gateway; cancel webview; assert app returns to review or canceled screen instead of success celebration

issue: Missing gateway redirect URL defaults to success step with PAID receipt
user_impact: Gateway failure returning empty redirect_url is treated as successful deposit
evidence_snippet: if (redirectUrl == null || redirectUrl.isEmpty) { pendingPaymentData.value = payload; currentStep.value = 2;
recommended_fix: Show error toast that payment gateway did not provide a payment link; do not advance to success step
regression_test_idea: Simulate backend response with empty redirect_url; assert error shown and step remains on review

issue: Asynchronous withdrawal request stamped as PAID and Confirmed on digital receipt
user_impact: Backend creates pending transaction in ledger (liability:pending_withdraw); receipt displays green Success badge and PAID watermark
recommended_fix: Pass EcardoReceiptStatus.pending to EcardoDigitalReceipt; show PENDING watermark and Processing status
regression_test_idea: Submit withdrawal; inspect receipt widget properties; assert watermarkText is PENDING and status is pending

issue: Hardcoded fallback rate of 95000 IRT severely conflicts with live rate of 188500 IRT triggering backend 2% slippage rejection
user_impact: User views rate at 95000 or 188500 IRT; when submitting expected_rate backend ExchangeService 2% slippage guard rejects transaction with 422 error
recommended_fix: Remove arbitrary hardcoded rates; sync fallback benchmark with backend currencies table or require fresh rate fetch before exchange
regression_test_idea: Simulate rate disparity >2%; verify backend rejects with slippage error and app prompts user to refresh rate

issue: Missing /user/payment/make endpoint in _idempotentEndpointSuffixes
user_impact: Merchant payments (make payment) do not carry Idempotency-Key or X-Idempotency-Key headers; network timeout retry risks double-paying merchant
recommended_fix: Add '/user/payment/make' to _idempotentEndpointSuffixes in NetworkService
regression_test_idea: Inspect HTTP headers on makePayment call; verify Idempotency-Key and X-Idempotency-Key headers are present

issue: PublicLiveRateSource hardcodes baselineUsdtToman to 188500 while ExchangeRateManager benchmark has 95000
user_impact: Inconsistent rate sources produce diverging cross-rates depending on which network call succeeds or fails
recommended_fix: Centralize baseline rate constants into a single synchronized configuration or fetch initial rates from backend settings API
regression_test_idea: Test rate resolution when fee.ecardo.ir times out; verify rate matches backend conversion_rate

issue: Hardcoded liveUsdToIrt = 95000.0 causes balance secondary equivalent to flash and double on screen
user_impact: When app opens or is offline USD balance displays secondary Toman equivalent at 95000; when live rates load it jumps to real market rate
recommended_fix: Use null or wallet conversionRate when live rates are unavailable; do not display inaccurate hardcoded 95000 equivalent
regression_test_idea: Launch home screen in airplane mode; verify secondary equivalent does not show false 95000 rate calculation

issue: Missing double-submission guard in giftCodeRedeem and missing idempotency endpoint suffix
user_impact: Double-tapping redeem button fires two simultaneous HTTP requests; endpoint /user/gifts/redeem lacks idempotency header
recommended_fix: Add if (isGiftRedeemLoading.isTrue) return; guard and add '/user/gifts/redeem' to _idempotentEndpointSuffixes
regression_test_idea: Rapid double-tap redeem button; verify NetworkService receives only one outgoing POST request

issue: Accept request money moves funds without idempotency header
user_impact: Accepting incoming money request debits wallet without idempotency header; transport timeout retry can double-debit
recommended_fix: Add request-money action endpoint pattern to _idempotentEndpointSuffixes or pass explicit operationId
regression_test_idea: Inspect request headers on submitRequestAction(action: accept); assert Idempotency-Key is present

issue: Passing wallet name instead of currencyCode to DynamicDecimalsHelper causes 0-decimal currencies to display cents
user_impact: IRT and IRR wallets display with 2 decimal places (e.g. 500000.00 IRT) on make payment success receipt
recommended_fix: Change currencyCode to currentWallet?.code ?? 'USD'
regression_test_idea: Complete payment with IRT wallet; verify receipt amount formats with 0 decimal places (no .00)

issue: Passing wallet name instead of currencyCode to DynamicDecimalsHelper in request money success receipt
user_impact: IRT and IRR request receipts format amounts with 2 decimal places instead of 0
recommended_fix: Change currencyCode to currentWallet?.code ?? walletCode
regression_test_idea: Create request money with IRT wallet; verify receipt amount has 0 decimal digits

issue: Multi-currency transactions naively summed together without currency conversion
user_impact: User having transactions in USD EUR and IRT sees a single nonsensical total summing dollars euros and tomans into one dollar figure
evidence_snippet: totalInflow += amount; totalOutflow += amount; ... if (currencySymbol.isEmpty) currencySymbol = '\$';
recommended_fix: Group transaction metrics by currency or convert to site base currency before summing
regression_test_idea: Load transactions with mixed currencies (10 USD + 100000 IRT); assert summary does not sum them into 100010

issue: Force-unwrapping nested gift map and missing gift code display on success screen
user_impact: If created_at is null or non-standard format app crashes with unhandled exception; generated gift code is never shown to user
recommended_fix: Use safe navigation ?. and show the generated gift code with copy button; migrate to EcardoDigitalReceipt
regression_test_idea: Mock backend gift creation response with null created_at; verify screen renders gracefully without throwing

issue: USDT formats to 8 decimals when isCrypto is true
user_impact: USDT amounts render with 8 decimal places (e.g. 25.12000000 USDT) exposing micro-rounding artifacts and cluttering UI
recommended_fix: Add USDT to _twoDecimalCurrencies or special-case stablecoins to return 2 (max 6 on crypto transfer)
regression_test_idea: Format USDT amount with isCrypto true; verify it outputs 2 decimals instead of 8

issue: Missing timeout catch and cautionary warning in submitWithdraw
user_impact: Network timeout on withdrawal displays generic error toast; user may re-submit immediately thinking it failed
recommended_fix: Add NetworkErrorHelper.isTimeout check with warning toast to check transaction history before retrying
regression_test_idea: Simulate DioExceptionType.receiveTimeout on submitWithdraw; verify warning toast is displayed

issue: Missing timeout catch and cautionary warning in makePayment
user_impact: Network timeout on merchant payment displays generic error toast prompting user to retry
recommended_fix: Add NetworkErrorHelper.isTimeout check with warning toast to check transaction history before retrying
regression_test_idea: Simulate receive timeout on makePayment; verify warning toast is displayed
